PZZ700-212130-
107 AM PST Sat Nov 21 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1023 mb high was situated over the northeastern tip of
California, and a 1003 mb low was over the Raton Ridge in 
northeastern NM. Flow is weakly offshore for today. Weak onshore 
flow returns tomorrow, increasing Sunday night, then decreasing 
for Monday and Tuesday. Winds and seas look to increase again late
Wednesday into Thursday.
